# September 02, 2026


# Silicom Secures $5M+/Yr Design Win with Tier-1 Cloud-Based Cyber Security Customer for 5G-Enabled Edge Networking Device


**KFAR SAVA, Israel – September 2, 2026 – Silicom Ltd. (NASDAQ:[SILC](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/silc) )** , a leading provider of networking and data infrastructure solutions, today announced that it has secured a Design Win from a new customer, a tier-1 cloud-based cyber security giant, for a Silicom Edge Networking device featuring integrated 5G wireless connectivity.


The customer has already placed an initial order and anticipates placing additional orders in the near term, with ramp-up expected to begin before the end of 2026. At full ramp-up, revenues associated with this Design Win are projected to exceed $5 million annually for this device alone.


“This new Design Win with a tier-1 cloud-based cyber security leader is further proof of the strong and accelerating momentum in our core business, where we continue to win new customers and deepen relationships with existing ones.” commented Liron Eizenman, Silicom’s CEO. “We are proud that after evaluating our solution for many months, the customer selected Silicom specifically for the strength of our integrated cellular connectivity, which proved to be a key differentiator in a competitive process.”


Mr. Eizenman continued, “In parallel, we are also evaluating additional, higher-end Edge devices with the customer, including a GPU-integrated Edge device designed for Edge AI use cases. Should the customer select this additional platform, revenue from this strategic relationship could grow significantly beyond current expectations.”


Mr. Eizenman concluded, “This makes our eighth Design Win this year, matching the total number of Design Wins we secured during the entirety of 2025. With this accelerating momentum, we are more optimistic than ever about our continued growth in 2027 and beyond, further compounding the phenomenal revenue growth of over 50% we expect this year.”


*******


**About Silicom**
Silicom Ltd. is an industry-leading provider of high-performance networking and data infrastructure solutions. Designed to optimize performance and efficiency in Cloud, Data Center and Edge environments, Silicom’s solutions increase throughput and minimize latency, serving as the infrastructure backbone for today’s most critical technologies. Our innovations empower high-demand workloads across Artificial Intelligence (AI) inference, SD-WAN, SASE, cyber security, fabric switching, NFV, and more.


Our comprehensive portfolio, including high-speed server adapters, advanced hardware offloading and acceleration engines, AI NICs, FPGA-based smart cards, Post Quantum Cryptography (PQC) hardware accelerators, white label switches and Edge CPEs, is used by Tier-1 customers throughout the world, including cloud players, service providers and OEMs, to enable their networks to scale efficiently. With engineering excellence, a strong financial position and a legacy of over 400 active Design Wins, Silicom serves as the “go-to” connectivity and performance partner for technology leaders around the globe, and drives the next generation of infrastructure.
